subject.title: [Bug]: Mattermost interaction token forgeable via hardcoded HMAC derivation key

question: What durable Mattermost interaction-signing model should replace the bot-token-derived HMAC secret?
rationale: The source-level vulnerability is clear, but the safe replacement changes a security boundary and likely adds credential/setup behavior that affects existing Mattermost deployments.

options.title: Require Durable Credential Provisioning
options.body: Use a configured or persisted per-account interaction secret with setup, SecretRef, docs, doctor/upgrade handling, and restart or split-process proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Explicit Fail-Closed Setup
options.body: Require operators to configure an interaction secret and make missing configuration fail closed with clear docs, setup messaging, and tests.

options.title: Pause For Security Design
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers choose the credential model, then replace or refresh the current conflicting PR.

recommendation.title: Require Durable Credential Provisioning
recommendation.body: Use a configured or persisted per-account interaction secret with setup, SecretRef, docs, doctor/upgrade handling, and restart or split-process proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the most recent merged Mattermost interaction hardening history and current-source carry-forward evidence for this route family.
